Subject: StratusTech — Dedicated GPU capacity architecture session

Hi team,

StratusTech asked for a focused architecture deep-dive on dedicated GPU capacity next week. They specifically want to cover pool sizing, autoscaling behavior under mixed workloads, and isolation strategies (multi-tenant failover, noisy-neighbor mitigation).

Proposed goals for the session (60–75m):
- Quick context + production workloads (10m)
- Pool sizing recommendations and expected throughput (15m)
- Autoscale policies, backpressure, and burst options (15m)
- Isolation and fallback strategies (15m)
- Open Q&A and next steps (10m)

Can you confirm who can present each section? My ask: Marissa covers sizing & throughput; Karthik covers autoscale policies; Kimberly covers isolation/failover. I attached the latest capacity playbook and draft slides for reference.

Also need to lock a few 60–75m slots (PDT):
- Tue 2026-09-29 10:00–11:15
- Wed 2026-09-30 15:00–16:15
- Thu 2026-10-01 08:30–09:45

I plan to send an external invite after we confirm presenters.

Thanks,
Jordan

- Can we get a short list of the StratusTech workload profiles (percent short prompts, few-shot, embeddings-heavy batch jobs)? If they can't share raw traces, summary percentiles are fine.
- I'd like to include a short slide on best-practice quantization and KV-cache sizing tradeoffs (will update slides).

Karthik — can you confirm your availability for autoscale section on Wed 9/30 15:00–16:15 PDT? Kimberly — please prep isolation examples (failover runbook + circuit breakers).

Marissa
